# GEO report: brightside-dental **New to GEO?** GEO (generative engine optimization) means making your site easy for search engines and AI tools to find, read and quote. This report checks the technical basics. ## Code score: 73/100, Good Confidence: High (checked 25 of 25 points). How it's calculated: low = 18.25 ÷ 25 × 100 = 73. High = (18.25 + 0) ÷ 25 × 100 = 73. This is a small, static Eleventy site, and the basics (robots.txt, sitemap, server-rendered content, links) are in good shape. Four things cost points. Every page's canonical tag (the tag that names the official address of a page) points at a staging host, the page language is missing, the structured data is broken JSON, and the Services page is hidden from search. No result depends on anything outside the code, so there are no unknowns. All results are read from code. ## Live check - **Not run.** To add it, give me your site's URL. ## Do these first ### 1. Point canonical tags at the real domain - **Why it matters:** Every page tells search engines its official address is on `staging.…`, not the `www.` site in your config, robots.txt and sitemap. That sends mixed signals about which address to index. - **Where:** `src/_includes/base.njk:8` - **What the code says:** `` - **Size:** Small - **Score after this:** 81/100 (GEO-015 goes from 0 to 2 of 2). ### 2. Add the page language and the missing team description - **Why it matters:** Without `lang`, machines and screen readers must guess the language. The Team page also has no description, so it falls back to an empty meta tag. - **Where:** `src/_includes/base.njk:2`, `src/team.njk:1-4` - **What the code says:** `` (no `lang`), and the Team front matter has only `title: Meet the team` - **Size:** Small - **Score after this:** 81/100 (GEO-012 goes from 0 to 2 of 2). ### 3. Fix the broken structured data on the Contact page - **Why it matters:** The JSON-LD (machine-readable business details) has a trailing comma, which makes it invalid JSON. Parsers will discard the whole block. - **Where:** `src/contact.njk:10` - **What the code says:** `"telephone": "0113 496 0000", }` - **Size:** Small - **Score after this:** 81/100 (GEO-004 goes from 0 to 2 of 2). ## All results | Rule | What it checks | Code | Where | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | GEO-013 | robots.txt is valid | Clear | `src/robots.txt`, copied by `.eleventy.js:1` | | GEO-009 | Search crawlers allowed | Clear | `src/robots.txt:1-2` (`User-agent: *` / `Allow: /`); policy is `allow` | | GEO-014 | Listed pages are indexable | Problem | `src/services.njk:5` (`noindex: true`); 3 of 4 routes clear, so 2.25 of 3 | | GEO-015 | Absolute canonical on own origin | Problem | `src/_includes/base.njk:8`, site-wide | | GEO-003 | Content is in server HTML | Clear | Eleventy static build | | GEO-004 | JSON-LD is valid | Problem | `src/contact.njk:10`, trailing comma; the only JSON-LD found | | GEO-011 | Sitemap is valid and discoverable | Clear | `src/sitemap.xml`, absolute `Sitemap:` line in `src/robots.txt:3` | | GEO-012 | Title, description and `lang` | Problem | No `lang` at `base.njk:2` (site-wide); no description on `src/team.njk` | | GEO-016 | Pages reachable through links | Clear | `base.njk:12` nav uses plain `` | | GEO-017 | No snippet conflicts | Clear | Only `data-nosnippet` on one element (`contact.njk:8`), which is a deliberate scoped choice | | GEO-002 | Accessibility basics | Clear | Read `base.njk` and the one image (`index.njk:8`, has `alt`) | | GEO-101 | App association files | Not applicable | No app declared | | GEO-010 | llms.txt | Not scored | None present | | GEO-102 | App structured data | Not scored | Not an app | ## Other problems found - **Services page is noindexed but listed in the sitemap and nav.** `src/services.njk:5`: `noindex: true`. If this is a leftover from staging, remove it. If it's deliberate, drop the page from `src/sitemap.xml:4`. Your main service page is currently invisible to search. - **Image file is missing from the repo.** `src/index.njk:8`: ``. No `img/` folder exists, and `.eleventy.js` doesn't copy one, so this likely 404s. Add the file and a passthrough copy. ## Worth considering - **Back up "Trusted by thousands":** `src/index.njk:7`: `Trusted by thousands of local patients.` Add a real figure, review count or years in practice, so the claim has something behind it. - **Show real prices:** `src/services.njk:9`: `Our prices are simple and clear.` The page has no prices. List them, or the starting price for each treatment. - **Name the dentists:** `src/team.njk:6`: `Our experienced dentists have decades of experience…` Add names, qualifications and registration numbers, and use Dentist or Person structured data. - **Give each service its own page:** `src/services.njk:8`: `
  • Implants
    • …`. Separate pages (for example `/services/implants/`) can each answer one question and be linked and cited on their own. - **Complete the Dentist JSON-LD:** `src/contact.njk:10`. The page shows `12 Park Row, Leeds` but the JSON-LD has no `address`, `url`, `openingHours` or `image`. Add them. - **Add opening hours and emergency details:** `src/contact.njk:7`: `Call 0113 496 0000 or visit 12 Park Row, Leeds.` The home page promises "Emergency appointments available" but gives no hours or emergency number. - **Add social tags:** `src/_includes/base.njk:3-10` has no `og:title`, `og:description` or `og:image`. Add them so shared links look right. - **Add `lastmod` to the sitemap:** `src/sitemap.xml:3-6` has no dates. Add them if you keep real update dates. - **Link onward from service and team pages:** `src/services.njk:9` and `src/team.njk:6` have no links to booking or contact beyond the nav. ## Can't tell from code - **Bot protection:** code can't show whether a CDN or firewall lets real crawlers through. Run `geopilot logs ` to check real crawlers against their published addresses. - **Live-only checks** (status codes, redirects, `X-Robots-Tag` headers, canonical targets answering 200) need a running site. Give me the URL to run them. ## Assumptions - You want AI search tools to find this site (`policy.aiSearchCrawlers` is `allow`). - `https://www.brightside-dental.example` is the real origin, from `geo.config.json`. - I read all 5 pages, the layout, `.eleventy.js`, `robots.txt`, `sitemap.xml` and the config. The one JSON-LD source is on the Contact page. `thanks.njk` is deliberately noindex and not in the sitemap, so I left it out of the indexability count. ## What to do next 1. Run the geopilot `fix` command to apply item 1. You'll see every change before anything is written. 2. Run the geopilot `explain` command with any rule id, such as `GEO-014`, to learn more. 3. For proof from a running site, ask for a live scan with its URL. Technical readiness only. GEO does not measure or predict citations, rankings, traffic or inclusion in any AI or search product.
